info.name: CoreLogic Trestle Direct Web API — CRM Contacts Member API

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression. Field names are case-sensitive and must match $metadata.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to inline-expand.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields with optional asc / desc modifiers.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default 10, maximum 1000 (300000 for key-only queries).

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

params.name: $count
params.description: When true, includes the total count of matching records in @odata.count.

items.docs: Returns MLS Member (agent) records matching OData query options.

params.name: MemberKey
params.description: The unique RESO MemberKey for the Member record.

items.docs: Returns a single Member record by MemberKey.
